objective: Replace artificial-sounding Kingdom ambience and generic gameplay notification WAVs with offline, professionally authored CC0 fantasy music and dedicated event SFX on Android staging only.
chosenApproach: Vendored pinned CC0 recordings, asset manifest Git hash validation, focused audio lifecycle cleanup with local pool, never remote Rork preview audio.
preserveBehaviors: 39 individually-profiled staging Kingdom scenes and 13 characters from R9
Existing R8 Skia/Reanimated game feedback hooks
Native runtime 1.3.2 and existing Expo modules
Audio mute, quiet hours, per-user opt-in map music
PTT/calls/reels video remain unmanaged by Kingdom
acceptanceChecks: All 12 source recordings present in branch with manifest SHA and size
Source and native/web TypeScript compile; audio runtime in installed staging APK
Music starts only on game focus, respects toggle, no playback after blur/background
Quick actions do not fall back to app message/notification sounds
Staging Android real device listening QA before OTA acceptance
Standalone Rork source contract and cinematic audio regression are exercised separately but only PR-changed tests are declared for mandatory release scope gate.
productionBaselineEvidence: Owner-approved latest staging visual DEV source at f4ed2fc362913b2532a981ce098c4e9c72b9becf includes already merged R9 visuals; port only 22 audio-path changes. No production OTA or actual staging APK claim.
selectionRationale: Use already-composed CC0 original game music and dedicated CC0 event sounds pinned to immutable Git blob hashes. Existing app notification WAVs are inappropriate as premium game feedback; no per-play network or paid synthesis. Metro needs explicit OGG asset registration to resolve these Android-native audio assets; this is bundler configuration only (no native ABI or installed package change).
alternativeApproaches: Keep synthesized background and normal notification sounds (rejected; owner sound quality complaint)
Stream from unreliable Rork preview host (rejected; missing offline resilience and prior 404)
Ship author-made licensed CC0 recordings offline with bounded Expo audio players (selected)
